quality.notes: Only per-cycle capacity and partial-charge features are stored (no voltage, current or temperature waveforms). working_profile names the load profile of each cell. No manufacturer or model name is given for any of the pouch/prismatic cells - only chemistry and form factor. dimensions_mm stay null. The registry lists NCA-LFP, so the collection-level cathode is mixed rather than LFP alone. This registry label does not independently assign cathode chemistry to each delivered MAT cell. Charging profile: the delivered files hold capacities and partial charge curves, not full current traces, so the labels come from the per-cell working profile. The landing page says the datasets hold pouch and prismatic cells; the record carries pouch only because the per-cell form factors are not in the raw files. The Mendeley page (version 9, published 29 October 2024, CC BY 4.0, author Yunhong Che, institutions Chongqing University and Aalborg University) names the paper to cite. The page says the charge capacity is the ampere-hour throughput in charging mode, so the capacity of Dataset 1 also counts the charging pulses of the dynamic discharge, and that the SOH curves are normalised by the charge capacity; Dataset 5 is raw data taken from a different study, Lyu et al., 'The explainable uncertainty in degradation process: a discovery from non-accelerated batteries degradation experiment', IECON 2022, 10.1109/IECON49645.2022.9969107 (data shared by Dr. Dongzhen Lyu). The paper (Che et al., Cell Reports Physical Science 4 (2023) 101743; main text and supplementary information read) describes the five datasets: 55 commercial pouch and prismatic cells with 116,681 cycles in total. Dataset 1 holds 15 pouch cells aged after ultra-fast charging with urban (UDDS), highway (HWFET) and hybrid dynamic discharge profiles (two 24 min cycles at two SOC stages) and one constant-current benchmark cell, at constant or periodically changed temperature (25-35 C and 25-15 C); dataset 2 is the same cells in second life (CC-CV charge and CC discharge, constant and variable temperature) - these are the 30 'Dataset1_Dataset2' entries here (15 primary and 15 'SL'); datasets 3 and 4 are 100 Ah prismatic cells aged at different constant temperatures (25, 35 and 55 C) and charge/discharge rates (1/1, 0.3/1 and 0.5/0.5 C) - the 11 'Dataset3' and 6 'Dataset4' entries; dataset 5 (small polymer cells aged at room temperature with 1/3C to SOH below 0.4, taken from the Lyu et al. study) is not among the delivered files. The delivered form factor is pouch for the 30 first cells and prismatic for the 17 others; the single dataset-level value is pouch (the majority), so the landing-page finding about prismatic cells stays. The cell chemistry of each dataset is not stated in the main text: its Figure 2A lists NCA, LFP and polymer, and the voltage ranges used for the Q-V input are 3.6-4.2 V for NCA and polymer cells and 3.3-3.5 V for LFP cells, but which dataset holds which chemistry is not given (the registry says NCA-LFP). Capacity is normalised by the fresh capacity at 25 C, and 'charge capacity' is the charging ampere-hour throughput, as the Mendeley page notes. Data and code availability points to Mendeley version 2 (n3b54nsw8m/2); this record is version 9. Supplementary Table 1 (supplied) settles the per-dataset cells: Datasets 1 and 2 are NCA/C pouch cells, 8 Ah, 2.7-4.2 V (15 cells; dataset 2 is the same cells as retired power batteries); Datasets 3 and 4 are LFP/C prismatic cells, 100 Ah, 2.5-3.65 V, from two manufacturers, used as energy batteries; Dataset 5 is a polymer prismatic cell (NMC:LMO 3:2 with C anode), 150 mAh, 2.7-4.2 V, 8 cells at room temperature with 1/3C, not delivered. So the 30 Dataset1_Dataset2 entries are NCA pouch and the 17 Dataset3/Dataset4 entries are LFP prismatic; the form factor and chemistry are now stored per cell and the collection-level values are the majority (pouch) and mixed. Supplementary Table 2: dataset 1 charges with multi-stage CC-CV (10C-5C-3C-1C then 0.1C CV) and discharges with UDDS, hybrid or HWFET combined with CC, benchmark cells at CC 2.5C, at 25 °C or cycling 25-35-25-15 °C; dataset 2 CC-CV (2.5C to 0.1C CV) with CC 2.5C discharge; dataset 3 CC-CV at 1C or 0.3C (0.05C CV) with 1C discharge at 25, 35 and 55 °C; dataset 4 0.5C or 1C at 35, 55, 25 °C. The recorded maximum charge 1.0C does not cover dataset 1 (10C stages) or dataset 2 (2.5C): charge_c_rate_max and discharge_c_rate_max are set from this table. Rate groups: the multi-stage CC-CV charge of dataset 1 (10C-5C-3C-1C, no single rate) against the 2.5C CC discharge of its benchmark cells, listed as a group with no charge rates.
